_note: Paper Sec. 5.1-5.2. The interventional means are analytic (E[x3|do(x2=a)] = -0.25 + 0.25a), so what is checked is the flow's error against them, not a pinned flow value: a center plus an error bound on the same number gave two windows that could disagree. do(x2=-3) is off-manifold extrapolation, which is why its error is the largest of the three. Measured with the reference implementation's own comparison net (comparison/utils.R::make_model: dense(10, tanh) -> dense(100, tanh)), M = 30. Across shuffle seeds 0-3 this fit spans 0.19 for do(x2=-3), so a changed seed is expected to break these bounds -- shuffle_seed is pinned in the config for that reason.
